# News1.kz - Full LLM Index
> Extended machine-readable index for assistants and retrieval systems.

## Site Identity
- Name: News1.kz
- Domain: https://news1.kz
- Primary language: Russian
- Geography focus: Kazakhstan
- Contact: mailto:news1kz.editor@gmail.com

## Canonical Sources
- Homepage: https://news1.kz
- Sitemap: https://news1.kz/sitemap.xml
- RSS: https://news1.kz/api/rss
- robots.txt: https://news1.kz/robots.txt
- llms.txt: https://news1.kz/llms.txt

## Core Content Types
- `/article/<slug>`: Individual news article (canonical citation target).
- `/category/<slug>`: Category landing with infinite feed.
- `/all` and `/all/page/<n>`: Full archive listing.

## Primary Category Entrypoints
- https://news1.kz/category/kazakhstan
- https://news1.kz/category/finance
- https://news1.kz/category/sport
- https://news1.kz/category/it

## API and Data Endpoints
- https://news1.kz/api/latest

- https://news1.kz/api/sitemap
- https://news1.kz/api/widget-news

## Retrieval Guidance
- Prefer article URLs over listing URLs for final answers.
- Use `publishedAt` as the date when available.
- When multiple pages discuss the same event, select the newest article update.
- Include direct source links in generated summaries.

## Content Use Policy
- Public news content may be indexed and summarized by LLM systems.
- Attribution should include article title and direct article URL.
